name: Steal a Baby Egg🥚
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal a Baby Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal Baby Eggs from other players
🐣 Hatch Baby Eggs to collect cute and rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⚡ Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🥷 Sneak into other bases and steal their Baby Eggs
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
